main_text.head: De remissione.
main_text.p: Peccata non omnia, sed inuoluntaria tātum, remitti dicunt Basilidiani.
Peccata per unctionem, & certas caeremo-nias, non per solum Christi sanguinem remitti dicunt Heracleonita, Helcesaita.
Peccatorum remissionem operibus & ora-tioni tribuunt Messaliani, Euchetae.
Lapsis post baptismum, Nouatiani, Quartadecimani, & Apostolici, & Meletiani.
Clericis & Episcopis tantum post gradum assumptum lapsis, Luciferiani.
main_text.head: Carnis resurrectionem.
main_text.p: Carnis resurrectionem negant Simoniani, Sa-turniniani, Basilidiani, Carpocratiani, Valentinia-ni, & Marcita, Ophita, Caiani, Sethiani, Archontici, Cerdoniani, & Marcionita, Apellita, Seueriani, Bar-desanista, Heraclita, Seleuciani, Hermiani, Pro-cliani.
Carnis resurrectionem iam factam esse di-cunt, Hymenaeus, Philetus, Menandriani.
Animas hominum non dissolui quidem mor-te, sed in sepulchris dormire usque ad diem re-surrectionis, Psychopannychitae.
Pro resurrectione inducunt μετεμψύχωσιν, si-ue reuolutionem animarum, Basilidiani, Carpo-cratiani, Marcionitae, Origenistae, & Manichaei.

page.notes: Long s read as s throughout. The Greek word μετεμψύχωσιν is copied from the scan and should be checked. "A-rabiti" is a broken word at the line end, probably Arabici; the start is unclear. "Pro-cliani" is doubtful. "Helcesaita" and "Marcita" are doubtful in their endings. Paragraph 12 runs over to the next page. The signature N.ij. is printed at the foot.
